skills.description: Preserve reset, enable, pipeline latency, and data/valid alignment in sequential RTL.
skills.summary: Follow specified reset polarity/synchrony and enable priority. Nonblocking RHS uses old state. Align data and valid; do not add an unspecified register or pipeline cycle.

skills.description: Implement complete combinational assignments and specified mux priority.
skills.summary: Assign every combinational output on every path; avoid unintended latches. Preserve specified priority and defaults. Use blocking assignments in combinational procedural logic.

skills.description: Make arithmetic widths, sign extension, shifts, and truncation explicit.
skills.summary: Explicitly widen operands before arithmetic; keep signedness consistent. Check shifts, sign extension, overflow and truncation at the exact specified output width.

skills.description: Preserve FSM output cycles and transaction state across packet completion and consumption.
skills.summary: Distinguish Moore from Mealy output timing. Trace old-state transitions at sequence boundaries; preserve packet/transaction state until its specified completion or consumption event.

skills.description: Specify accepted FIFO operations, boundary behavior, occupancy, and read latency.
skills.summary: Derive accepted reads/writes from the specified empty/full policy, especially simultaneous operations at boundaries. Wrap pointers at the actual depth and preserve read latency.

skills.description: Use the supported SystemVerilog synthesis subset without changing functional latency.
skills.summary: Use synthesizable SystemVerilog supported by the tool. When fixing an unsupported construct, preserve bit widths, memory read latency and all specified cycle behavior.
